_why: Questions kept out of the pool entirely. Each was caught by verify_allocation.py after a first allocation pass, and each is a defect in the question rather than something a threshold should decide. The pool has ~600 spare questions, so replacing is cheaper and safer than hand-repairing a source defect.

ids.satmath-ma2-linear-inequalities-19: Stem is corrupted: '\( y \( y > -4x - 7 \)' opens a math span twice and the first inequality of the system is missing, yet the stem says 'system of inequalities'.
ids.sathard-geometry-100: Stem says 'In the circle shown' and carries the book's 'Note: Figure not drawn to scale' caption, but the transcriber marked needsFigure false, so no figure was built. The bisected-chord configuration cannot be read from the prose alone.
ids.satmath-ma2-areas-volumes-40: 'The figure shown consists of a rectangle WXYZ and a semicircle' — which side the semicircle sits on is only in the picture, and no figure was built.
ids.satmath-ma3-triangles-11: 'Triangles ABC and A'B'C' are shown' — the correspondence between vertices is only in the picture, and no figure was built.
ids.sathard-advanced-math-76: The transcriber derived -600; the four printed choices are -322, -457, -603 and -789. -600 is close to C but not equal to it, so either the stem's constants or the derivation is wrong. Not shippable either way.
ids.sathard-problem-solving-63: All four answer choices are dot plots drawn into one image, so the choice TEXT is the same placeholder string four times. It renders as four identical options.
